label: verification control

charter.note: The charter describes this control in prose only (negative_controls[0].change and .restore), so the changed title is copied here and checked against that text when the definition is loaded. The declared title is read from the charter's fixture_setup.bookmarks, never from this file.

endpoint: PATCH /api/v4/channels/{channel_id}/bookmarks/{bookmark_id} with a JSON body holding only display_name, sent as the seeding admin who owns the bookmark. The bookmark is updated in place and keeps its id; a patch by anyone else would soft-delete it and save a copy with a new id.
